description: Rate and extent of a 5.5 Hz vibrato on a 220 Hz saw, mono and on a 7-voice unison, read by librosa pYIN and an FFT peak.

issue_figures.why: the issue gives the 24-cent extent and its share of 0.69 once, for the 35-cent truth, so it is checked on the mono 35-cent case only; extent checks the sine amplitude that the #288 plan fixed, extent_p2p checks half the peak-to-peak span that #67 defines, and only extent enters reproduced

name: 67-vibrato

recipe.extent: the sine amplitude at that bin, 2 |X| / sum(w), fixed in the #288 plan before measuring; #67 defines the extent as half the peak-to-peak span, which equals the amplitude only for a clean sine, so half the peak-to-peak span of the detrended window is recorded too, with its own flag outside reproduced
recipe.note: the #67 method: frame 2048, hop 128 at 22,050 Hz, a 0.5 to 1 s window, an FFT peak in 3 to 12 Hz; the issue states no fmin, fmax, window shape or length, so the pYIN settings of 61-glide and the signal of this repository's vibrato tests are used
recipe.rate_by_window: for information, the rate from the same spectrum over windows of 0.5 and 0.75 s centred on the tone, and over the frames centred in the whole 1 s tone; a window of L s resolves rates to about 1 / L Hz before zero padding

signal.pitch: f0 2^(extent sin(2 pi rate t) / 1200), t from the tone start
signal.voices: the Vibrato of tests/it/support/pitch.rs: the saws and unison of 66-glide, lead_s of silence before and after the tone

recipe.spectrum: linear detrend, symmetric Hann, FFT zero-padded to 32768 points (0.0053 Hz bins), largest magnitude between 3 and 12 Hz, no interpolation
recipe.tolerance: rates within 0.01 Hz: the issue's rounding plus about two bins; extent within 5 %
recipe.window: the track frames whose centres lie in the tone less 50 ms at each end, all voiced, in cents over f0

rounding: the issue prints rates to 0.01 Hz and the extent in whole cents
tolerance_note: abs applies to the rates, rel to the extent
